title: Grade 7 students reported 2nd highest reading MCA participation at Gentry Academy Middle in 2024-25
text:
Grade 7 students reported 2nd highest reading MCA participation at Gentry Academy Middle in 2024-25
K. R. Tan
The Minnesota Department of Education reported that at Gentry Academy Middle, grade 7 students represented the second highest participation rate in the reading section of the 2024-25 MCA.
Out of 199 test-takers for the reading MCA portion at Gentry Academy Middle, 52 were identified as seventh-graders.
Test standards showed that 48% of grade 7 participants were proficient in reading.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) serve as Minnesota’s state tests for gauging student progress toward academic standards, fulfilling both federal and state legislative requirements. Math, reading and science assessments are administered depending on grade. Most students take the MCA; those receiving special education services and qualifying are eligible for Alt MCA.
Minnesota's Report Card shows that overall MCA proficiency across the state has decreased from pre-pandemic data. Math proficiency scores have fallen by over 7% since 2019 and reading scores declined by nearly 5%.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in reading |
|---|---|---|
| 5th | 52 | 60% |
| 6th | 51 | 59% |
| 7th | 52 | 48% |
| 8th | 44 | 43% |
Information in this article was obtained from the Minnesota Department of Education. The source data can be found here.
